children: RNS Number : 8631E  Henderson High Income Trust PLC  26 November 2026
JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
Henderson High Income Trust plc is pleased to announce the appointment of
Mark Wharrier as a non-executive director of the Company with effect from

Mark is an experienced UK equity investor with more than 30 years’ investment management experience, specialising in UK equities and equity income. At BlackRock, he led the UK Equity Income franchise and managed the BlackRock UK Income Fund and BlackRock Income & Growth Investment Trust plc. He is a member of the Investment Committees of Onward Opportunities Limited and Durham University. He was formerly a founding partner of NewSmith Asset Management and held senior investment roles at Mercury Asset Management, Troy Asset Management and Majedie Asset Management.
In accordance with paragraphs 6.4.8 (1) to (6) of the UK Listing Rules, it is confirmed that there are no details to be disclosed in relation to Mark Wharrier.
